fields.Name: Voting Administrator
fields.Description: Administer elections: create, configure, open, close, tally and certify votes. Issue credentials and manage voter rolls.

fields.Name: Election Inspector
fields.Description: Observe election administration: view turnout and results after close, verify receipts and participate in ballot reconciliation and certification.

fields.Name: Voting Ballot Engine
fields.Description: Held ONLY by the MemberJunction system user. Grants the voting engines (which run as the system user) read, create and update on the ballot-box entities: Cast Ballots, Ballot Selections, Contest Running Tallies and Ballot Attributions. No person, API key or other role may hold it: those entities are created with no other role permissions, so this role is what keeps every other principal out of the ballot box.
